2115115137011192060.en_summary: Microsoft’s $MSFT custom Maia chips are expected to account for roughly 10% of its AI chip spending by early 2027, per Evercore, with the remainder flowing to Nvidia $NVDA and AMD's $AMD systems.

2115115054979027377.en_summary: $NDAQ CEO: Nasdaq is already charging premiums for financial data delivered through MCP connectors, with additional AI pricing models under consideration. Upcharging for MCP connector data, and will look at different pricing as AI use cases expand.

2115114442975580472.en_summary: $CBRS and $ORCL are teaming up to bring Cerebras AI inference to Oracle Cloud in 2027. Cerebras CEO notes every step an agent makes requires inference, speed matters more for complex tasks. Cerebras doesn't need to replace $NVDA or $AMD to win share in speed-critical workloads.
2115114442975580472.zh_summary: $CBRS和$ORCL合作，將Cerebras AI推理帶入Oracle Cloud，計劃於2027年。Cerebras CEO表示代理每一步都需要推理，速度對複雜任務更重要。Cerebras無需取代$NVDA或$AMD即可在速度關鍵的工作負載中贏得份額。
